### 📦 Downloads & Compatibility

| Package | Target | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`wuspotify-muter-TAG_NAME-macos-universal.tar.gz`** | **Universal** | **Recommended** — Native on all Macs (Apple Silicon & Intel) |
| `wuspotify-muter-TAG_NAME-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | Apple Silicon | Apple Silicon Macs (M-series) |
| `wuspotify-muter-TAG_NAME-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` | Intel | Intel x86_64 Macs |

> Compatible with macOS 11 (Big Sur), macOS 12 (Monterey), macOS 13 (Ventura), macOS 14 (Sonoma), and macOS 15 (Sequoia).

### 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Extract
tar -xzf wuspotify-muter-*-macos-universal.tar.gz

# Run
./wuspotify-muter
```

*(If macOS blocks execution with a Gatekeeper warning on browser downloads, run: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine wuspotify-muter`)*
